myths-and-legends-of-our-own-land-volume: Charles Skinner opens his great folklore collection along the Hudson River and its hills. Ghosts of Dutch settlers, Revolutionary soldiers, and river pirates haunt these tales gathered from local legend. The volume shows Skinner's gift for making America's backyard as rich in story as any old country.
catholic-encyclopedia-1913-adalbert-i: This 1913 reference article on Adalbert I — the medieval German prelate of stormy times. John Joseph A'Becket gives his career. Church and empire tugged at his loyalty. A prince-bishop of the old Reich.
